claims.quote: Barnet welcomed the appearance of the atomic engine with the zest of masculine youth in all fresh machinery
claims.description: Atomic-powered engines become a new everyday machine technology.

claims.quote: These new helicopters, we found,’ he notes, ‘had abolished all the danger and strain of sudden drops to which the old-time aeroplanes were liable
claims.description: Atomic-powered helicopters that fly safely without the sudden drops of aeroplanes.

claims.quote: Barnet saw the last days of the coal-steam engines upon the English railways and the gradual cleansing of the London atmosphere as the smoke-creating sea-coal fires gave place to electric heating.
claims.description: Coal-steam railways and coal fires are replaced by electric heating, cleaning London's air.

claims.quote: London, under the Visible Smoke Law, by which any production of visible smoke with or without excuse was punishable by a fine
claims.description: A law fines any production of visible smoke in London.

claims.quote: The insanitary horse and the plebeian bicycle had been banished from the roadway, which was now of a resilient, glass-like surface, spotlessly clean;
claims.description: City roads are resurfaced with a clean glass-like material and horses and bicycles are banned from them.

claims.quote: the new ways for pedestrians, the Rows, that ran along the front of the houses at the level of the first story
claims.description: Cities gain elevated pedestrian walkways at first-story level joined by bridges.

claims.quote: the police had power to challenge and demand the Labour Card of any indigent-looking person, and if the record failed to show he was in employment, dismiss him to the traffic pavement below.
claims.description: Police can demand a labor card proving employment and expel the unemployed from the walkways.

claims.quote: Above rose great frontages of intricate rather than beautiful reinforced porcelain, studded with lights
claims.description: Building facades are made of reinforced porcelain.

claims.quote: the men had struck that day against the use of an atomic riveter that would have doubled the individual efficiency and halved the number of steel workers.
claims.description: An atomic riveter doubles worker efficiency, provoking a strike over lost jobs.

claims.quote: the papers, which were printed upon thin sheets of metallic foil, were sold at determinate points by specially licensed purveyors.
claims.description: Newspapers are printed on thin metallic foil and sold at licensed kiosks.

claims.quote: When presently he got within sight of the transparencies that had replaced the placards of Victorian times
claims.description: Illuminated transparent news displays replace paper placards.

claims.quote: They were a sample of that great mass of unskilled cheap labour which the now still cheaper mechanical powers had superseded for evermore.
claims.description: Mechanical and atomic power permanently displaces unskilled labor, creating mass unemployment.

claims.quote: led to the appearance of what came to be called the ‘Modern State’ movement
claims.description: A movement arises for a scientifically planned state rearranging property, employment, education and government.

claims.quote: He belonged until the financial *débâcle* of 1956 to the class of fairly prosperous people
claims.description: A financial collapse in 1956 destroys the fortunes of the prosperous class.

claims.quote: when all the railway stations were removed to the south side of the river
claims.description: London's railway stations are relocated to the south side of the Thames.

claims.quote: since giving to wayfarers had been made a punishable offence
claims.description: Giving alms to wayfarers becomes a criminal offense.

claims.quote: This time it was talk of the Central European powers suddenly attacking the Slav Confederacy, with France and England going to the help of the Slavs.
claims.description: A European war breaks out between Central European powers and a Slav Confederacy backed by France and England.

claims.quote: the war that fills the histories of the middle decades of the twentieth century
claims.description: A great war occupies the middle decades of the twentieth century.
claims.stated_time: the middle decades of the twentieth century
